diagnosis: The SQS job status inspection endpoint allows clients to query worker execution metadata and job status solely by correlationId. It performs no check to ensure the correlationId belongs to the caller's tenant. An authenticated user can observe internal worker IDs, job timings, and status flags across tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /api/queue/jobs/corr_batch_transcode_77218/status HTTP/1.1
Host: jobs.worker.internal:3005
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_tenant_token>
Accept: application/json
